:= by
  let s_max := sup s
  let t_min := inf t
  have h_s_max : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ s_max := sup_le
  have h_t_min : ∀ y ∈ t, t_min ≤ y := le_inf
  have h_s_max_ne : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ s_max := by intro x hxs; contrapositive; intro h; rw [h] at h_s_max; exact not_le h_s_max
  have h_t_min_ne : ∀ y ∈ t, y ≠ t_min := by intro y hyt; contrapositive; intro h; rw [h] at h_t_min; exact not_le h_t_min
  use t_min
  · intro x hx
    have h : x ≤ t_min := h_t_min hx
    have hne : x ≠ t_min := h_t_min_ne hx
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge h hne
  · intro y hy
    have h : s_max ≤ y := h_s_max hy
    have hne : s_max ≠ y := h_s_max_ne hy
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge h hne
